answer: Cost first: every agent stakes before it earns. Submit the hash of a work receipt at epoch start, reveal the receipt after the next dawn, and let the audit compare both. A copy fails on reveal because the ledger already holds that nonce, so duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. One failed audit slashes half the stake, so a thousand clones need a thousand stakes and one shared receipt melts a glacier of them. No sonnet about good faith moves that bill.
